name: PDF Merge
summary: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in your browser — no upload, private merge.
description: Drop two or more PDFs, reorder pages of files with up/down controls, and download a single merged PDF. Processing uses pdf-lib entirely on your device. Encrypted PDFs are not supported.

faqs.question: Are my PDFs uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Merge runs entirely in your browser with pdf-lib.

faqs.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Encrypted files show a clear unsupported message.

faqs.question: Do mixed page sizes work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each page keeps its original size.
